title: BR-11c · P hand
line: A sleeve squeezes the whole knee. A hinged brace stops it going sideways, and her knee was never going sideways. A gel sits on the skin. None of them move the load.
notes: rubs white gel from a plain unlabelled tube onto her knee skin · one rub, 2s · L-P-KITCH · P-D2 · high/three-quarter/CU — high = sits on the skin, from above · pip · EG02 · EG06 crossed-out list · product: absent
